cc036f2955.en: {1}About:{/1} A full-day CVPR 2024 workshop bringing academia and industry together (UCLA, Tübingen, NVIDIA, Waymo, Zoox/MIT, Wayve, Argoverse) on the state of autonomous driving. This report distills the talks with substantive notes.
cc036f2955.zh: {1}简介：{/1}一场为期一整天的 CVPR 2024 研讨会，汇集学术界和产业界（UCLA、Tübingen、NVIDIA、Waymo、Zoox/MIT、Wayve、Argoverse），讨论自动驾驶的现状。本报告提炼各场报告并附有详实的笔记。

5ba3a884cf.en: Three threads ran through the day: open-source simulation & benchmarking to close the academia–industry gap; foundation / vision-language models moving into every layer of the AV stack; and scaling to the long tail with robust, end-to-end autonomy.
5ba3a884cf.zh: 全天贯穿三条主线：开源仿真与基准测试，以缩小学术界与产业界的差距；基础模型/视觉语言模型进入自动驾驶技术栈的每一层；以及通过鲁棒的端到端自主性应对长尾场景的规模化。

8dae140448.en: An Open-Source Simulation Ecosystem for AV Research
8dae140448.zh: An Open-Source Simulation Ecosystem for AV Research

2a7200ef30.en: Academia is limited by hardware/GPU constraints; access to real-world data and simulators bridges the gap to industry
2a7200ef30.zh: 学术界受限于硬件/GPU；获取真实世界数据和仿真器可以弥合与产业界的差距

14fba07c48.en: AV companies release real-world datasets — but they need a common format
14fba07c48.zh: 自动驾驶公司发布真实世界数据集，但这些数据集需要统一的格式

a1b1c6b484.en: An open-source simulator that mimics real-world quality is essential
a1b1c6b484.zh: 能够模拟真实世界质量的开源仿真器至关重要

88952a186c.zh: MetaDrive：一个轻量级、数据驱动的仿真器

47db2d431f.en: ScenarioNet: a large-scale repository built from low-resolution labeled data — 500,000 scenarios so far
47db2d431f.zh: ScenarioNet：基于低分辨率标注数据构建的大规模场景库，目前已有 500,000 个场景

5ba51d3a05.en: Users add their own modules; a two-stage method turns noisy, fragmented data into coherent scenarios
5ba51d3a05.zh: 用户可以添加自己的模块；两阶段方法将有噪声、碎片化的数据转化为连贯的场景

e59a2cbbcc.en: Safety-critical scenarios are rare → closed-loop adversarial training adds adversarial scenarios and risk-aware driving
e59a2cbbcc.zh: 安全关键场景很罕见 → 闭环对抗训练增加对抗场景和风险感知驾驶

2542c04818.en: Text-to-image VLMs create diverse, high-quality images; simulator-conditioned generation (SimGen) yields realistic scenes
2542c04818.zh: 文生图视觉语言模型能生成多样、高质量的图像；以仿真器为条件的生成（SimGen）可产生逼真的场景

69de77b5db.en: Work underway on urban environments for small-robot city simulation
69de77b5db.zh: 正在开展面向小型机器人城市仿真的城市环境工作

2754faa5b3.en: ScenarioNet — turning real-world logs into large-scale, reusable driving scenarios.
2754faa5b3.zh: ScenarioNet — 将真实世界日志转化为大规模、可复用的驾驶场景。

4b178291d3.en: {1}Kashyap Chitta{/1} · University of Tübingen · Tübingen AI Center
4b178291d3.zh: {1}Kashyap Chitta{/1} · University of Tübingen · Tübingen AI Center

3d25c438d8.zh: 为什么用非反应式仿真

6c40621a90.en: 75% of driving data is just driving straight; current sims are limited, not very realistic, and GPU-hungry
6c40621a90.zh: 75% 的驾驶数据只是直线行驶；现有仿真器能力有限、不够逼真，而且非常消耗 GPU

38f9d7c9af.en: Bypass these constraints with minimal rendering in a 2D bird's-eye-view simulation
38f9d7c9af.zh: 通过2D 鸟瞰图仿真中的最小化渲染来绕开这些限制

eb9bc8d172.en: The ego vehicle is restricted to its first frame; the whole simulation runs without new sensor data (assume the initial data is complete)
eb9bc8d172.zh: 自车被限制在其第一帧；整个仿真在没有新传感器数据的情况下运行（假设初始数据是完整的）

54a13ed65f.en: The ego vehicle is invisible to other vehicles' sensors — hence ‘non-reactive’
54a13ed65f.zh: 自车对其他车辆的传感器不可见，因此称为“非反应式”

545292708f.zh: 无碰撞 · 行驶区域合规 · 碰撞时间

8ae464fd24.en: Ego progress · comfort of driving — all in a lightweight 2D BEV
8ae464fd24.zh: 自车行进进度 · 驾驶舒适度，全部在轻量级的2D BEV 中完成

f3c9e4077b.en: Non-reactive simulation — a lightweight 2D bird's-eye view where the ego vehicle is invisible to others.
f3c9e4077b.zh: 非反应式仿真 — 一种轻量级的2D 鸟瞰视图，其中自车对其他车辆不可见。

09efffd14d.en: NVIDIA spans ADAS across hardware, infrastructure, simulation, NVIDIA Drive and research
09efffd14d.zh: NVIDIA 的 ADAS 覆盖硬件、基础设施、仿真、NVIDIA Drive 和研究

c022e4c2f6.en: Shift from rule-based systems to AI / end-to-end models, which simplify ADS software
c022e4c2f6.zh: 从基于规则的系统转向 AI/端到端模型，这简化了 ADS 软件

a6db79b408.en: Rare cases need rapid processing — slow iteration is not acceptable
a6db79b408.zh: 罕见情况需要快速处理，缓慢的迭代是不可接受的

7be1a3811d.en: Vision-Language Models enable auto-labeling, captioning and clustering; video captions feed later analysis
7be1a3811d.zh: 视觉语言模型支持自动标注、生成描述和聚类；视频描述为后续分析提供输入

180b09e6a1.en: New tools: Picasso (text-to-image), NeMo, ViLA (captioning), DLSS 3.0; the Blackwell GPU adds generative AI
180b09e6a1.zh: 新工具：Picasso（文生图）、NeMo、ViLA（生成描述）、DLSS 3.0；Blackwell GPU 加入了生成式 AI

d9a5a784c2.en: FM-powered AV stack: images → trajectory tokens → pretrained backbone → driving stack, benchmarked in simulation
d9a5a784c2.zh: 基于基础模型的自动驾驶技术栈：图像 → 轨迹 token → 预训练骨干网络 → 驾驶技术栈，并在仿真中进行基准测试

dcba69c344.en: Model harsh-weather video from internet video, given the rarity of real accident data
dcba69c344.zh: 由于真实事故数据稀少，利用互联网视频对恶劣天气视频进行建模

a7b2963c77.en: Use enough tokens to model small objects (e.g. pillars) without slowing down; dynamic scenes (motorcycles) stay hard
a7b2963c77.zh: 使用足够的 token 来建模小物体（例如立柱）而不降低速度；动态场景（摩托车）仍然困难

b6ab2d96f6.en: A simulation-first approach using neural reconstruction graphics
b6ab2d96f6.zh: 采用神经重建图形的仿真优先方法

e8fa57ea30.en: NVIDIA's foundation-model stack generating realistic driving video, including harsh-weather scenes.
e8fa57ea30.zh: NVIDIA 的基础模型技术栈生成逼真的驾驶视频，包括恶劣天气场景。

eee9fc1207.en: Buckle Up for the Future: Scaling Autonomous Driving
eee9fc1207.zh: Buckle Up for the Future: Scaling Autonomous Driving

de83b2f30c.en: Each year ~50 million injuries and 1.35 million deaths occur on the streets
de83b2f30c.zh: 每年街头约有 5000 万人受伤、135 万人死亡

22dc5a6c3c.en: Long-tail handling is the critical challenge for scaling autonomous driving
22dc5a6c3c.zh: 长尾处理是自动驾驶规模化的关键挑战

6f467af9e2.en: Multi-modality sensor fusion; mining and augmenting rare examples
6f467af9e2.zh: 多模态传感器融合；挖掘并扩充罕见样本

67149ee6df.en: Auto-labeling plus an efficient ML development ecosystem
67149ee6df.zh: 自动标注，加上高效的机器学习开发生态

e9e8417708.en: Next step: leverage the knowledge and reasoning of LLMs / VLMs
e9e8417708.zh: 下一步：利用大语言模型/视觉语言模型的知识与推理能力

301654f061.en: Human labeling is slow and inaccurate for scaling → focus on a perception database (billions of points and images)
301654f061.zh: 人工标注速度慢且不够准确，难以规模化 → 聚焦于感知数据库（数十亿个点和图像）

f81877b083.en: UP-VL: unsupervised multi-modal auto-labeling + 3D perception trained with vision-language distillation — no human annotations
f81877b083.zh: UP-VL：无监督多模态自动标注 + 通过视觉语言蒸馏训练的3D 感知，无需人工标注

f0659c6581.en: A hybrid paradigm: combine classic methods with end-to-end approaches
f0659c6581.zh: 一种混合范式：将经典方法与端到端方法结合

0c797dab29.en: Waymo — ‘driving is a conversation’: LLM-inspired discrete motion tokens over a causal scene decoder.
0c797dab29.zh: Waymo —“驾驶是一场对话”：受大语言模型启发的离散运动 token，搭配因果场景解码器。

3e3d4287d8.en: Argoverse Challenges — Scene Flow, Forecasting & Occupancy
3e3d4287d8.zh: Argoverse Challenges — Scene Flow, Forecasting & Occupancy

d852c3af8d.en: Datasets of image, lidar and more; scene flow spans background, vehicles and pedestrians
d852c3af8d.zh: 包含图像、激光雷达等的数据集；场景流涵盖背景、车辆和行人

5022423793.en: A simple Kalman filter tracked changes between consecutive frames to detect moving objects
5022423793.zh: 一个简单的卡尔曼滤波器跟踪连续帧之间的变化，以检测运动物体

01e54c246e.en: Flow4D: early and temporal fusion, fusing lidar and camera information
01e54c246e.zh: Flow4D：早期融合与时间融合，融合激光雷达和摄像头信息

a506de70a7.en: Clustering + ICP: high-quality priors; improved clustering via foreground/background estimation
a506de70a7.zh: 聚类 + ICP：高质量先验；通过前景/背景估计改进聚类

8b3704caef.en: End-to-end forecasting: various sensor-fusion methods, but performance issues on the AV stack — ongoing work
8b3704caef.zh: 端到端预测：有多种传感器融合方法，但在自动驾驶技术栈上存在性能问题，相关工作仍在进行

8f2f608325.en: 4D occupancy forecasting without annotations via an implicit model; parallel processing of large query sets
8f2f608325.zh: 通过隐式模型在无标注的情况下进行 4D 占用预测；并行处理大规模查询集

e66d523160.en: A large receptive field helps find lidar evidence; most foreground motion is in the BEV plane
e66d523160.zh: 较大的感受野有助于找到激光雷达证据；大多数前景运动发生在 BEV 平面内

51bcb11d29.en: Flow4D — early fusion of multi-frame lidar into a 4D voxel network for scene-flow estimation.
51bcb11d29.zh: Flow4D — 将多帧激光雷达早期融合进 4D 体素网络，用于场景流估计。

8d1adbb086.en: A general ADS architecture; end-to-end AI can replace individual modules, connecting sensors directly to motors
8d1adbb086.zh: 通用的 ADS 架构；端到端 AI 可以替代单个模块，将传感器直接连接到电机

4e159f2668.en: Learned estimators trained with domain knowledge help generate data — but the number of sensors is a challenge
4e159f2668.zh: 结合领域知识训练的学习式估计器有助于生成数据，但传感器数量是一个挑战

e468f44c34.en: Debris is hard to detect and is often mistaken for noise; buses must be perceived and avoided
e468f44c34.zh: 碎片难以检测，常被误认为噪声；必须感知并避让公交车

cc5cf7b3aa.en: Significant out-of-domain uncertainty is computationally heavy and vulnerable to aliasing
cc5cf7b3aa.zh: 显著的域外不确定性计算量很大，并且容易受到混叠影响

66dad1c58c.en: Reinforcement learning is used for the planning module
66dad1c58c.zh: 规划模块使用强化学习

e25c1a683c.en: Open question: how to match standard methods with end-to-end approaches
e25c1a683c.zh: 开放问题：如何让标准方法与端到端方法相匹配

1004f9c0b6.en: Robust autonomy in the wild — detecting road debris and other rare, out-of-domain hazards.
1004f9c0b6.zh: 真实环境中的鲁棒自主性 — 检测道路碎片和其他罕见的域外危险。

4907e8d0aa.en: Open-source simulators and a common scenario format (MetaDrive / ScenarioNet) are closing the academia–industry gap.
4907e8d0aa.zh: 开源仿真器和统一的场景格式（MetaDrive / ScenarioNet）正在缩小学术界与产业界的差距。

0d0d86493b.en: Foundation / vision-language models are moving into every layer of the AV stack — labeling, generation, planning.
0d0d86493b.zh: 基础模型/视觉语言模型正在进入自动驾驶技术栈的每一层——标注、生成、规划。

2f6e7c8ddf.en: The field is converging on end-to-end, simulation-first development.
2f6e7c8ddf.zh: 该领域正在趋向于端到端、仿真优先的开发方式。

1f3be12d6a.en: Label-free 3D perception at scale (UP-VL) and auto-generated safety-critical scenarios.
1f3be12d6a.zh: 大规模无标签3D 感知（UP-VL）和自动生成的安全关键场景。

a4e45a1c0c.en: Realistic generative simulation — harsh weather and accidents — from internet-scale video.
a4e45a1c0c.zh: 基于互联网规模视频的逼真生成式仿真——恶劣天气和事故。

0b4896b9e5.en: Robust autonomy that handles the long tail: debris, rare events, out-of-domain uncertainty.
0b4896b9e5.zh: 能处理长尾的鲁棒自主性：碎片、罕见事件、域外不确定性。

e16248563c.en: Invest in open simulation, benchmarking and a shared scenario format.
e16248563c.zh: 投入开源仿真、基准测试和共享的场景格式。

7ed5956072.en: Adopt VLM-powered auto-labeling and generative data to cover rare cases cheaply.
7ed5956072.zh: 采用由视觉语言模型驱动的自动标注和生成式数据，以低成本覆盖罕见情况。

5383f77387.en: Treat long-tail robustness and safety validation as first-class, not add-ons.
5383f77387.zh: 将长尾鲁棒性和安全确认视为一等公民，而不是附加项。

b83d80c2ba.en:
Trends

  • Open-source simulators and a common scenario format (MetaDrive / ScenarioNet) are closing the academia–industry gap.
  • Foundation / vision-language models are moving into every layer of the AV stack — labeling, generation, planning.
  • The field is converging on end-to-end, simulation-first development.

Vision

  • Label-free 3D perception at scale (UP-VL) and auto-generated safety-critical scenarios.
  • Realistic generative simulation — harsh weather and accidents — from internet-scale video.
  • Robust autonomy that handles the long tail: debris, rare events, out-of-domain uncertainty.

Implications for us

  • Invest in open simulation, benchmarking and a shared scenario format.
  • Adopt VLM-powered auto-labeling and generative data to cover rare cases cheaply.
  • Treat long-tail robustness and safety validation as first-class, not add-ons.
b83d80c2ba.zh:
趋势

  • 开源仿真器和统一的场景格式（MetaDrive / ScenarioNet）正在缩小学术界与产业界的差距。
  • 基础模型/视觉语言模型正在进入自动驾驶技术栈的每一层——标注、生成、规划。
  • 该领域正在趋向于端到端、仿真优先的开发方式。

愿景

  • 大规模无标签3D 感知（UP-VL）和自动生成的安全关键场景。
  • 基于互联网规模视频的逼真生成式仿真——恶劣天气和事故。
  • 能处理长尾的鲁棒自主性：碎片、罕见事件、域外不确定性。

对我们的启示

  • 投入开源仿真、基准测试和共享的场景格式。
  • 采用由视觉语言模型驱动的自动标注和生成式数据，以低成本覆盖罕见情况。
  • 将长尾鲁棒性和安全确认视为一等公民，而不是附加项。

83d36b3e5f.zh: 美国华盛顿州西雅图 · 2024 年 6 月 17 日

3b0de4dbbb.en: Autonomous Driving — Simulation, Foundation Models & Robust Autonomy
3b0de4dbbb.zh: 自动驾驶 — 仿真、基础模型与鲁棒自主性

9c909d67a7.en: About: A full-day CVPR 2024 workshop bringing academia and industry together (UCLA, Tübingen, NVIDIA, Waymo, Zoox/MIT, Wayve, Argoverse) on the state of autonomous driving. This report distills the talks with substantive notes.
9c909d67a7.zh: 简介：一场为期一整天的 CVPR 2024 研讨会，汇集学术界和产业界（UCLA、Tübingen、NVIDIA、Waymo、Zoox/MIT、Wayve、Argoverse），讨论自动驾驶的现状。本报告提炼各场报告并附有详实的笔记。

cedf0c18f2.zh: 洞察 01 · 仿真与基准测试

fae4047575.en: • Academia is limited by hardware/GPU constraints; access to real-world data and simulators bridges the gap to industry
fae4047575.zh: • 学术界受限于硬件/GPU；获取真实世界数据和仿真器可以弥合与产业界的差距

48fc5d8862.en: • AV companies release real-world datasets — but they need a common format
48fc5d8862.zh: • 自动驾驶公司发布真实世界数据集，但这些数据集需要统一的格式

6f84aef3df.en: • An open-source simulator that mimics real-world quality is essential
6f84aef3df.zh: • 能够模拟真实世界质量的开源仿真器至关重要

71026ab49c.zh: • MetaDrive：一个轻量级、数据驱动的仿真器

84c33604cd.en: • ScenarioNet: a large-scale repository built from low-resolution labeled data — 500,000 scenarios so far
84c33604cd.zh: • ScenarioNet：基于低分辨率标注数据构建的大规模场景库，目前已有 500,000 个场景

91e1fc3ed0.en: • Users add their own modules; a two-stage method turns noisy, fragmented data into coherent scenarios
91e1fc3ed0.zh: • 用户可以添加自己的模块；两阶段方法将有噪声、碎片化的数据转化为连贯的场景

4a29915945.en: • Safety-critical scenarios are rare → closed-loop adversarial training adds adversarial scenarios and risk-aware driving
4a29915945.zh: • 安全关键场景很罕见 → 闭环对抗训练增加对抗场景和风险感知驾驶

30674e8292.en: • Text-to-image VLMs create diverse, high-quality images; simulator-conditioned generation (SimGen) yields realistic scenes
30674e8292.zh: • 文生图视觉语言模型能生成多样、高质量的图像；以仿真器为条件的生成（SimGen）可产生逼真的场景

037e9cef8b.en: • Work underway on urban environments for small-robot city simulation
037e9cef8b.zh: • 正在开展面向小型机器人城市仿真的城市环境工作

587558b99c.zh: 洞察 02 · 仿真与基准测试

8122fab04e.en: Kashyap Chitta · University of Tübingen · Tübingen AI Center
8122fab04e.zh: Kashyap Chitta · University of Tübingen · Tübingen AI Center

4687167352.zh: 为什么用非反应式仿真

b9a1a7506b.en: • 75% of driving data is just driving straight; current sims are limited, not very realistic, and GPU-hungry
b9a1a7506b.zh: • 75% 的驾驶数据只是直线行驶；现有仿真器能力有限、不够逼真，而且非常消耗 GPU

96b82a1333.en: • Bypass these constraints with minimal rendering in a 2D bird's-eye-view simulation
96b82a1333.zh: • 通过2D 鸟瞰图仿真中的最小化渲染来绕开这些限制

47143182c8.en: • The ego vehicle is restricted to its first frame; the whole simulation runs without new sensor data (assume the initial data is complete)
47143182c8.zh: • 自车被限制在其第一帧；整个仿真在没有新传感器数据的情况下运行（假设初始数据是完整的）

cc1c66b6e3.en: • The ego vehicle is invisible to other vehicles' sensors — hence ‘non-reactive’
cc1c66b6e3.zh: • 自车对其他车辆的传感器不可见，因此称为“非反应式”

28477f1f43.zh: • 无碰撞 · 行驶区域合规 · 碰撞时间

36df0cf89e.en: • Ego progress · comfort of driving — all in a lightweight 2D BEV
36df0cf89e.zh: • 自车行进进度 · 驾驶舒适度，全部在轻量级的2D BEV 中完成

0a9ee38970.zh: 洞察 03 · 基础模型与规模化

d8205be93f.en: • NVIDIA spans ADAS across hardware, infrastructure, simulation, NVIDIA Drive and research
d8205be93f.zh: • NVIDIA 的 ADAS 覆盖硬件、基础设施、仿真、NVIDIA Drive 和研究

579c30cc8a.en: • Shift from rule-based systems to AI / end-to-end models, which simplify ADS software
579c30cc8a.zh: • 从基于规则的系统转向 AI/端到端模型，这简化了 ADS 软件

7e74463195.en: • Rare cases need rapid processing — slow iteration is not acceptable
7e74463195.zh: • 罕见情况需要快速处理，缓慢的迭代是不可接受的

685dac70d0.en: • Vision-Language Models enable auto-labeling, captioning and clustering; video captions feed later analysis
685dac70d0.zh: • 视觉语言模型支持自动标注、生成描述和聚类；视频描述为后续分析提供输入

145ade255e.en: • New tools: Picasso (text-to-image), NeMo, ViLA (captioning), DLSS 3.0; the Blackwell GPU adds generative AI
145ade255e.zh: • 新工具：Picasso（文生图）、NeMo、ViLA（生成描述）、DLSS 3.0；Blackwell GPU 加入了生成式 AI

8bced9f126.en: • FM-powered AV stack: images → trajectory tokens → pretrained backbone → driving stack, benchmarked in simulation
8bced9f126.zh: • 基于基础模型的自动驾驶技术栈：图像 → 轨迹 token → 预训练骨干网络 → 驾驶技术栈，并在仿真中进行基准测试

c33793ff9b.en: • Model harsh-weather video from internet video, given the rarity of real accident data
c33793ff9b.zh: • 真实事故数据稀少，因此用互联网视频来建模恶劣天气视频

de887abbf8.en: • Use enough tokens to model small objects (e.g. pillars) without slowing down; dynamic scenes (motorcycles) stay hard
de887abbf8.zh: • 使用足够多的 token 来建模小物体（如立柱）而不降低速度；动态场景（如摩托车）依然困难

6fc3c22edd.en: • A simulation-first approach using neural reconstruction graphics
6fc3c22edd.zh: • 采用以仿真为先的方法，使用神经重建图形技术

bbb039a541.zh: 洞察 04 · 基础模型与规模化

e637f74877.en: • Each year ~50 million injuries and 1.35 million deaths occur on the streets
e637f74877.zh: • 每年街头约有 5000 万人受伤、135 万人死亡

ecbd99e04c.en: • Long-tail handling is the critical challenge for scaling autonomous driving
ecbd99e04c.zh: • 处理长尾问题是规模化自动驾驶的关键挑战

1f29a299b8.en: • Multi-modality sensor fusion; mining and augmenting rare examples
1f29a299b8.zh: • 多模态传感器融合；挖掘并增强罕见样本

43f7d11bbc.en: • Auto-labeling plus an efficient ML development ecosystem
43f7d11bbc.zh: • 自动标注，加上高效的机器学习开发生态

24eb0d9fac.en: • Next step: leverage the knowledge and reasoning of LLMs / VLMs
24eb0d9fac.zh: • 下一步：利用大语言模型 / 视觉语言模型的知识与推理能力

c30f967245.en: • Human labeling is slow and inaccurate for scaling → focus on a perception database (billions of points and images)
c30f967245.zh: • 人工标注速度慢且不够准确，难以规模化 → 聚焦感知数据库（数十亿个点和图像）

84ca1222ab.en: • UP-VL: unsupervised multi-modal auto-labeling + 3D perception trained with vision-language distillation — no human annotations
84ca1222ab.zh: • UP-VL：无监督多模态自动标注 + 通过视觉语言蒸馏训练的 3D 感知，无需人工标注

e0a05116ad.en: • A hybrid paradigm: combine classic methods with end-to-end approaches
e0a05116ad.zh: • 一种混合范式：将经典方法与端到端方法结合

bf3de96bd3.zh: 洞察 05 · 感知、预测与鲁棒自主性

a15b98c5f2.en: • Datasets of image, lidar and more; scene flow spans background, vehicles and pedestrians
a15b98c5f2.zh: • 包含图像、激光雷达等的数据集；场景流涵盖背景、车辆和行人

7c2e52e269.en: • A simple Kalman filter tracked changes between consecutive frames to detect moving objects
7c2e52e269.zh: • 用简单的卡尔曼滤波器跟踪连续帧之间的变化，以检测运动物体

2e0c48ad75.en: • Flow4D: early and temporal fusion, fusing lidar and camera information
2e0c48ad75.zh: • Flow4D：早期融合与时序融合，融合激光雷达和相机信息

b1877f9394.en: • Clustering + ICP: high-quality priors; improved clustering via foreground/background estimation
b1877f9394.zh: • 聚类 + ICP：高质量先验；通过前景/背景估计改进聚类

c44be7f8f2.en: • End-to-end forecasting: various sensor-fusion methods, but performance issues on the AV stack — ongoing work
c44be7f8f2.zh: • 端到端预测：有多种传感器融合方法，但在自动驾驶系统中存在性能问题，相关工作仍在进行

34b86c5d33.en: • 4D occupancy forecasting without annotations via an implicit model; parallel processing of large query sets
34b86c5d33.zh: • 通过隐式模型在无标注情况下进行 4D 占用预测；并行处理大规模查询集

6fd3f6eb7e.en: • A large receptive field helps find lidar evidence; most foreground motion is in the BEV plane
6fd3f6eb7e.zh: • 大感受野有助于找到激光雷达证据；大部分前景运动发生在 BEV 平面内

c5bf3c8b05.zh: 洞察 06 · 感知、预测与鲁棒自主性

f5d212443f.en: • A general ADS architecture; end-to-end AI can replace individual modules, connecting sensors directly to motors
f5d212443f.zh: • 通用的 ADS 架构；端到端 AI 可以替代单个模块，将传感器直接连接到电机

7fd85dcbb3.en: • Learned estimators trained with domain knowledge help generate data — but the number of sensors is a challenge
7fd85dcbb3.zh: • 结合领域知识训练的学习式估计器有助于生成数据，但传感器数量是一个挑战

b78c6d65d2.en: • Debris is hard to detect and is often mistaken for noise; buses must be perceived and avoided
b78c6d65d2.zh: • 碎片难以检测，常被误认为噪声；必须感知并避让公交车

7f4462942e.en: • Significant out-of-domain uncertainty is computationally heavy and vulnerable to aliasing
7f4462942e.zh: • 显著的域外不确定性计算量很大，且容易受到混叠影响

69a7b11062.en: • Reinforcement learning is used for the planning module
69a7b11062.zh: • 规划模块使用强化学习

77afaa875e.en: • Open question: how to match standard methods with end-to-end approaches
77afaa875e.zh: • 开放问题：如何让标准方法与端到端方法相匹配

01d9f78e85.en: • Open-source simulators and a common scenario format (MetaDrive / ScenarioNet) are closing the academia–industry gap.
01d9f78e85.zh: • 开源仿真器和通用场景格式（MetaDrive / ScenarioNet）正在缩小学术界与工业界的差距。

8c09ea5e54.en: • Foundation / vision-language models are moving into every layer of the AV stack — labeling, generation, planning.
8c09ea5e54.zh: • 基础模型 / 视觉语言模型正在进入自动驾驶系统的每一层：标注、生成、规划。

f039ca99e4.en: • The field is converging on end-to-end, simulation-first development.
f039ca99e4.zh: • 该领域正在向端到端、以仿真为先的开发方式收敛。

944649adbd.en: • Label-free 3D perception at scale (UP-VL) and auto-generated safety-critical scenarios.
944649adbd.zh: • 大规模无标注 3D 感知（UP-VL）以及自动生成的安全关键场景。

2d0d83a39d.en: • Realistic generative simulation — harsh weather and accidents — from internet-scale video.
2d0d83a39d.zh: • 基于互联网规模视频的逼真生成式仿真，涵盖恶劣天气和事故。

bf0609e4d6.en: • Robust autonomy that handles the long tail: debris, rare events, out-of-domain uncertainty.
bf0609e4d6.zh: • 能处理长尾问题的鲁棒自主性：碎片、罕见事件、域外不确定性。

88d7b65c63.en: • Invest in open simulation, benchmarking and a shared scenario format.
88d7b65c63.zh: • 投入开放仿真、基准测试和共享的场景格式。

6da43e8051.en: • Adopt VLM-powered auto-labeling and generative data to cover rare cases cheaply.
6da43e8051.zh: • 采用由视觉语言模型驱动的自动标注和生成式数据，以低成本覆盖罕见情况。

28422dbde6.en: • Treat long-tail robustness and safety validation as first-class, not add-ons.
28422dbde6.zh: • 把长尾鲁棒性和安全确认视为一等公民，而不是附加项。
